{{Quote|Taris Engineering Post here. Stabilizing Makeb's core is theoretically possible, but we don't have enough data.|A scientist at the Engineering Post|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel]]''</ref>}}
The '''Taris Engineering Post''' was a scientific outpost of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Taris/Legends|Taris]]. They were one of several Imperial scientific resources called in to consult on the Empire's efforts to halt the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Makeb]]'s destruction.
